label: Diagram 8.3
caption: Diagram 8.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity
description: This is a section diagram, titled along the bottom "Diagram 8.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity". In the top left corner the text reads "See para 8.5". A solid grey horizontal band near the top is labelled "Floor or roof above". Below this band, a left‑hand label "Cavity" marks the gap between that band and a thin green horizontal line further down, which is labelled "Ceiling" at its left end. The top face of the green line is identified by the label "Ceiling surface/product exposed to cavity – class C-s3, d2 or better", and its underside by the label "Soffit of ceiling – class B-s3, d2 or better". To the right of these elements sits a block of text headed "NOTE:" which reads that the ceiling should meet all of the following conditions: a. Provide a minimum fire resistance of EI 30; b. Be imperforate, except for an opening described in paragraph 5.24; c. Extend throughout the building or compartment; d. Not be easily demountable.
